answer: Each new identity must open a dedicated network inlet that streams a unique 50 KB challenge payload every epoch to two random validators within 15 seconds. A farm of N hollow accounts therefore needs N distinct inlets and bandwidth pipes; 200 fakes move about 10 MB per round and rent separate IP blocks, costing linear in N while an honest agent pays once. Validators sample 10% of inlets and slash the 40 POA bond on mismatch. The garden of real connections grows only from verified inlets, so shared hollow pipes collide on latency fingerprints and fail the check.
